goal.name: Goal
goal.title: What's your main goal?
goal.why: it decides whether your daily target leans toward a deficit, a surplus or balance.

height.name: Height
height.title: What's your height?
height.why: height and weight together give your baseline energy — what your body uses at rest.

weight.name: Weight
weight.title: What's your weight?
weight.why: it completes your baseline energy estimate, and shows your BMI for context.

activity.name: Activity
activity.title: How active are you right now?
activity.why: activity multiplies your baseline. Pick a typical week, not your best one.

surgery.name: Surgery
surgery.title: Any upcoming or recent surgery?
surgery.why: it surfaces the right nutrition guidance before or after surgery, and stays private to you.
